svg.aria-label: Waveforms of the genuine mixer, the Rust mixer and their difference for the synthetic session SNDDIST; differing samples: 0 of 30720
svg.text: Sound mixer, genuine against Rust: synthetic session SNDDIST
Our own generated test sounds, not the game's. Declared schedule: buffer k of 512 frames mixed after tic floor(512k/315).
Genuine: linuxdoom-1.10 built with its in-process sound code (one define removed)
Rust: the doom-sound mixer, same start list and lumps
Difference: Rust minus genuine, on the same scale
1.393 s: 15,360 stereo frames at 11,025 Hz, 30,720 signed 16-bit samples. Vertical scale ±2,224 (the genuine peak) in every lane.
Marks on the time axis: the 14 starts, each at the first frame that mixes it (9 different frames).
